edges.subject: CLN5
edges.quote: The Finnish-variant late infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, also known as CLN5 disease, is caused by mutations in the CLN5 gene.

edges.subject: CLN5 disease
edges.quote: Loss of Cln5 results in neuronal differentiation deficits and delays in interneuron development during in utero period.

edges.subject: RE1-silencing transcription factor
edges.quote: We show that the developmental deficits of interneurons may be linked to increased levels of the repressor element 1-silencing transcription factor, which we report to bind to glutamate decarboxylase (Gad1), which encodes GAD67, a rate-limiting enzyme in the production of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).
